title: 第1章 传承千年仙门！
slug: 先秦炼气两千年世人误闯天家
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

咸阳宫。

顾长青端坐蒲团，身姿挺拔。

偏僻无名的清幽院落与世隔绝，避开了皇城所有的喧嚣与权谋纷争。

【叮！仙门传承系统已永久绑定宿主顾长青！】

【上古隐世仙门「长青仙宗」传承完毕！仙界之门开启，可前往仙界修行。】

【宗门底蕴解锁：历经两千载岁月沉淀，十九代祖师薪火相传，积累海量仙道底蕴、完整修仙功法、上古秘术、镇宗心法！】

【当前状态：仙门隐世蛰伏，静待宿主执掌山门，于大秦现世，重开仙统！】

周身萦绕着一层若有若无的淡白色氤氲灵气，呼吸绵长悠远，吐纳间契合天地韵律。

自他意外穿越战国末年、大秦将统天下的时代，已足足半月有余。

初临这片陌生的古秦大地，看着巍峨的咸阳宫、身着古秦服饰的宫人，他曾满心惶恐与茫然。

可数日沉淀过后，所有慌乱尽数褪去，只剩满心的沉稳与淡然。

他早已彻底接受自己穿越的事实。

而真正让他立足乱世、无惧帝王皇权的，并非侥幸，而是绑定在神魂深处的专属金手指——【千年仙门传承系统】！

脑海中早已定格的系统提示，至今清晰无比。

他并非一无所有的穿越者。

两千年岁月，十九代仙门祖师呕心沥血。

从开宗立派、开山筑基，到完善道统、留存秘术、积累灵气底蕴，硬生生将「长青仙宗」打造成了一座底蕴滔天的隐世仙门。

只是仙门恪守隐世之道，代代避世不出，断绝凡尘纠葛，历经春秋战国乱世，始终隐匿于天地之间，无人知晓。

直至今日，跨越两千年时光的仙门传承，尽数落于顾长青一人身上。

他脑海中，完整版的《长青纳元心经》缓缓流转，这是仙宗开宗立派的根本功法，历经两千年打磨完善，远比寻常仙道典籍精妙万倍。

丝丝缕缕的天地灵气顺着周身毛孔涌入体内，洗髓伐脉，滋养肉身。

顾长青缓缓心神，眼底一片平静淡漠。

世人皆惧大秦铁血，敬畏始皇帝威权，视咸阳宫为至尊牢笼。

可唯有他清楚。

自两千载仙门传承加身的那一刻起，这凡尘大秦、赫赫皇权，于他而言，不过是浮生蝼蚁，红尘过客。

蛰伏咸阳，非是受制于人，而是他执掌两千年仙门道统，择机出世，欲在这大秦盛世，重耀万古仙门！

“呼……”

一口浊气被他长长吐出，在身前形成一道淡淡的白练，久久不散。

他能清晰地感觉到，丹田内的那一缕法力，已经壮大到了一个临界点，如同即将决堤的江河，正在疯狂冲击着一道无形的壁垒。

就是现在！

顾长青心神合一，引导着那股法力，汇聚成，朝着壁垒发起了最后的冲锋。

“轰！”

一声只存在于神魂之中的闷响炸开，那道坚固的壁垒瞬间土崩瓦解。

远比之前精纯、磅礴的暖流，从丹田涌出，瞬间流遍四肢百骸。

每一个毛孔都被

他的身体，他的神魂，在这一刻发生着某种难以言喻的蜕变。

炼气之境，成了！

就在此时，异变陡生。

原本平静的屋内，无端刮起一阵微风，吹得桌上竹简哗哗作响。

Page (1/3)

Xianyang Palace.

Gu Changqing sat upright on the futon, his posture upright.

The remote and nameless quiet courtyard is isolated from the world, avoiding all the hustle and bustle and power intrigues of the imperial city.

【bite!The Immortal Gate inheritance system has been permanently bound to the host Gu Changqing!】

[The inheritance of the ancient hidden immortal sect "Evergreen Immortal Sect" has been completed!The door to the fairy world is open, and you can go to the fairy world to practice.】

[Unlock the sect’s heritage: After two thousand years of accumulation, the 19th generation of ancestors has passed down the fire from generation to generation, accumulating massive immortality heritage, complete immortal cultivation techniques, ancient secret techniques, and sect-suppressing mental techniques!】

[Current status: The Immortal Sect is dormant in seclusion, waiting for the host to take charge of the gate, appear in the Qin Dynasty, and reopen the Immortal Lineage!】

There is a layer of faint white mist lingering around the whole body. The breath is long and distant, and the breath is in harmony with the rhythm of heaven and earth.

It has been more than half a month since he accidentally traveled to the end of the Warring States Period, when the Qin Dynasty ruled the world.

When he first came to this unfamiliar land of ancient Qin, he was filled with fear and confusion when he saw the majestic Xianyang Palace and the palace officials dressed in ancient Qin costumes.

But after a few days of settling down, all the panic faded away, leaving only a sense of calmness and indifference.

He had already completely accepted the fact that he had traveled through time.

What really allowed him to stand in troubled times and not fear the emperor's power was not luck, but the exclusive golden finger bound deep in his soul - [Thousand-year Immortal Sect inheritance system]!

The system prompts that have long been fixed in my mind are still very clear.

He is not a time traveler with nothing.

For two thousand years, the 19th generation founder of the Immortal Sect worked hard.

From establishing a sect and establishing a mountain to building a foundation, to perfecting the Taoism, retaining secret techniques, and accumulating spiritual energy, the "Evergreen Immortal Sect" has been forcibly built into a hidden celestial sect with overwhelming heritage.

It's just that the Immortal Sect adheres to the way of hiding from the world, avoiding the world for generations, cutting off the entanglements of the world. Through the turbulent times of the Spring and Autumn and Warring States, it has always been hidden between heaven and earth, and no one knows about it.

To this day, the inheritance of the Immortal Sect spanning two thousand years has all fallen to Gu Changqing.

In his mind, the complete version of the "Evergreen Nayuan Heart Sutra" slowly circulated. This is the fundamental technique for establishing the Immortal Sect. After two thousand years of polishing and perfection, it is far more sophisticated than ordinary Immortal Dao classics.

Wisps of spiritual energy from heaven and earth flow into the body along the pores all over the body, cleansing the marrow and veins, and nourishing the body.

Gu Changqing calmed down, his eyes looking calm and indifferent.

Everyone in the world is afraid of the iron blood of the Qin Dynasty, respects the authority of the First Emperor, and regards Xianyang Palace as the supreme prison.

But only he knows.

From the moment he inherited the two-thousand-year-old Immortal Sect, the great Qin Dynasty and the illustrious imperial power were nothing more than floating ants and passers-by in the world of mortals to him.

He was dormant in Xianyang, not because he was controlled by others, but because he had been in charge of the Immortal Sect's orthodoxy for two thousand years, and he chose the opportunity to be born, hoping to shine on the Eternal Immortal Sect in this prosperous age of the Qin Dynasty!

"Huh..."

He exhaled a long breath of turbid air, forming a faint white line in front of him that lingered for a long time.

He could clearly feel that the ray of magic power in his Dantian had grown to a critical point, like a river about to burst its banks, frantically impacting an invisible barrier.

That's it now!

Gu Changqing united his mind, guided the magic power, gathered it, and launched the final charge towards the barrier.

"Boom!"

A muffled sound that only existed in the soul exploded, and the solid barrier instantly collapsed.

A warm current that was far more pure and majestic than before surged out from the Dantian and instantly flowed through the limbs and bones.

Every pore is covered

His body and soul were undergoing some indescribable transformation at this moment.

The realm of qi refining is complete!

At this moment, a sudden change occurred.

In the originally peaceful room, a breeze blew out of nowhere, causing the bamboo slips on the table to rattle.
